library.name: Rail operations (administrators)
library.author: dana
library.description: The private side of Rail operations: the graphs, the backend that serves them, and the policy that decides who reads which graph.

dataGraphs.name: Operations: public

dataGraphs.name: Operations: finance

dataGraphs.name: Access rules
dataGraphs.description: Who may read which graph of Rail operations. Anyone reads public. The analysts group reads finance. The hr group reads finance and staff. Carol, by name, reads staff.

backends.name: Rail operations access rules
backends.description: The rules the graph policy reads.

backends.name: Rail operations

queries.name: Who reads which graph
queries.description: The graph policy for Rail operations: the graphs the caller may read. Anyone reads public; groups and named users read more. ?authUser and ?authGroup come from the demo person, and a guest has neither.
